import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

tk = yf.Ticker("600519.SS")
df = tk.history(period="1y", interval="1d", auto_adjust=False)

# clean
df = df.reset_index()
df = df.rename(columns={"Date":"date","Open":"open","High":"high","Low":"low","Close":"close","Volume":"volume"})
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"]).dt.tz_localize(None)
df = df[["date","open","high","low","close","volume"]].dropna().reset_index(drop=True)

# stats
c0 = df.iloc[0]["close"]
c1 = df.iloc[-1]["close"]
hi = df["high"].max(); lo = df["low"].min()
hid = df.loc[df["high"].idxmax(),"date"]; lod = df.loc[df["low"].idxmin(),"date"]
ret = (c1/c0-1)*100
vol = df["close"].pct_change().std()*np.sqrt(252)*100

df["ma5"]=df["close"].rolling(5).mean()
df["ma20"]=df["close"].rolling(20).mean()
df["ma60"]=df["close"].rolling(60).mean()

print("start", df.iloc[0]["date"].date(), "close", round(c0,2))
print("end", df.iloc[-1]["date"].date(), "close", round(c1,2))
print("period days", len(df))
print("high", round(hi,2), hid.date())
print("low", round(lo,2), lod.date())
print("return%", round(ret,2))
print("annvol%", round(vol,2))

# quarterly / half segmentation
for label, sub in [("前3月", df.iloc[:len(df)//4]), ("中段", df.iloc[len(df)//4:len(df)//2]),
                   ("后段", df.iloc[len(df)//2:])]:
    r=(sub.iloc[-1]["close"]/sub.iloc[0]["close"]-1)*100
    print(label, round(sub.iloc[0]["close"],2), "->", round(sub.iloc[-1]["close"],2), round(r,2), "%")

# last 60 days trend
r60=(c1/df.iloc[-60]["close"]-1)*100
r20=(c1/df.iloc[-20]["close"]-1)*100
print("近60日", round(r60,2), "%  近20日", round(r20,2), "%")
print("MA5", round(df["ma5"].iloc[-1],2), "MA20", round(df["ma20"].iloc[-1],2), "MA60", round(df["ma60"].iloc[-1],2))
print("dividends check", df[df["close"]!=df["close"]].shape)

# save csv
df.to_csv("/tmp/moutai_1y.csv", index=False)
print("saved csv")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager
import mplfinance as mpf

df = pd.read_csv("/tmp/moutai_1y.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
df = df.set_index("date")
df.columns = [c.capitalize() for c in df.columns]
df = df.rename(columns={"Open":"Open","High":"High","Low":"Low","Close":"Close","Volume":"Volume"})

# Chinese font
fpath = font_manager.findfont("Noto Sans CJK JP")
fp = font_manager.FontProperties(fname=fpath)
plt.rcParams["font.family"] = fp.get_name()
plt.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

hi = df["High"].max(); hid = df["High"].idxmax()
lo = df["Low"].min(); lod = df["Low"].idxmin()

# annotations for high/low
high_pt = (hid, hi)
low_pt = (lod, lo)

mc = mpf.make_marketcolors(up="r", down="g", edge="inherit", wick="inherit", volume="in")
style = mpf.make_mpf_style(marketcolors=mc, gridstyle=":", gridcolor="#dddddd",
                           facecolor="white", figcolor="white", rc={"font.family": fp.get_name()})

ap = [
    mpf.make_addplot(df["Close"].rolling(5).mean(), color="#1f77b4", width=1.1, label="MA5"),
    mpf.make_addplot(df["Close"].rolling(20).mean(), color="#ff9800", width=1.3, label="MA20"),
    mpf.make_addplot(df["Close"].rolling(60).mean(), color="#9c27b0", width=1.5, label="MA60"),
]

fig, axes = mpf.plot(df, type="candle", style=style, addplot=ap,
                     volume=True, mav=None,
                     title="\n贵州茅台（600519.SH）近一年日K线",
                     ylabel="价格（元）", ylabel_lower="成交量（手）",
                     figsize=(14, 9), returnfig=True,
                     datetime_format="%Y-%m", xrotation=0,
                     tight_layout=True)

ax = axes[0]
ax.annotate(f"阶段高点 {hi:.0f} 元\n({hid:%Y-%m-%d})", xy=(hid, hi),
            xytext=(hid, hi+40), ha="center",
            fontsize=10, color="#c62828",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#c62828"))
ax.annotate(f"阶段低点 {lo:.0f} 元\n({lod:%Y-%m-%d})", xy=(lod, lo),
            xytext=(lod, lo-95), ha="center",
            fontsize=10, color="#2e7d32",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#2e7d32"))

axes[0].legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=9)
fig.savefig("/tmp/moutai_kline.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print("saved", fig.get_size_inches())
print("hi", hi, hid, "lo", lo, lod)

## 走势结论

近一年呈「先涨—后跌—再反弹」的 N 型震荡格局，整体仍收跌。

- **区间**：收盘由 1467.98 元 → 1335.00 元，累计 **-9.06%**。
- **上行段**（2025-10 至 2026-02 初）：震荡走高，2 月 6 日见年内高点 **1568.00 元**，较期初 +6.8%。
- **回调段**（2026-02 中至 6 月底）：持续回落，6 月 29 日探年内低点 **1151.01 元**，自高点最大回撤约 **-26.6%**。
- **反弹段**（2026-07 起）：企稳回升，较低点反弹约 **+16.0%**；近 20 日 +6.2%、近 60 日 +2.9%。
- **均线**：现价站上 MA5(1324)、MA20(1281)、MA60(1299)，短期均线走多，短线偏强，但年内尚未收复失地。
- 年化波动率约 **22.7%**。

2025-10-23 至 2026-10-23，共 243 个交易日（前复权日线）。
